name: 06468 · Monroe, CT
findings: ZIP 06468 (Monroe) has 71 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06468 (Monroe) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 06468 (Monroe) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).
